summary: Theriva Biologics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose that Spanish regulator AEMPS authorized a Phase IIa clinical trial (VIRAGE2) testing increased-frequency dosing of VCN-01 plus chemotherapy in metastatic pancreatic cancer. The filing provides no special-situation M&A, corporate restructuring, or capital return terms. It is a routine clinical-regulatory update, not a special situation event. What to watch: standard drug-development milestones; no arbitrage angle exists.
